sprint: Every moveable object in Studio now gets the same two spatial controls: World Builder v2's own 8-direction Move pad (press-and-hold to repeat, tap the centre to reset) plus a NEW circular 360-degree Spin dial — the product owner's own words: "whenever there is a moveable flag true with any object i need the 8 direction mover like we did in builder along with 360 degree rotation spinner", answered as "A real circular dial" for "Every moveable object".
task: js/contextPanel.js gains _makeNudgePad (a faithful port of Builder's _v2NudgePad — same HOLD_DELAY 350ms / HOLD_REPEAT 80ms / 118px pad / 30px buttons / diagonal length normalization, and the same deliberately dumb contract: it emits only (dx,dy) unit steps and the caller decides what a step MEANS) and _makeRotationDial (genuinely new — Builder has no dial at all, rotation there is a plain range slider). One _spatialAdapter dispatches on ownership, mirroring js/app.js's own drag dispatch: a Story sticker's position/rotation live as instance fields (SceneEngine.updateSticker), everything else in elementOverrides (setPosition/setRotation), except a Place's rotation which uses setContentOverride — its own established 0..359 convention, and the one the renderer's permission-gated _resolvePlaceRotation reads back. Three EXISTING rotation sliders are DELETED rather than duplicated (the World-object rotationCell, the sticker Spin range row, and selectionActionStrip's _mountPlaceRotationSlider plus its call site) — one rotation control per surface, per the codebase's own if-unused-delete-completely convention. mountQuickEditControl now ORs its results instead of early-returning per branch, so a moveable-but-not-editable object genuinely mounts the pad+dial instead of falling through to the plain 'open the right panel' hint. Closes a real renderer gap in the same ship: _layerDrawSticker never read ov.rotation, so the new dial would have been dead for a World glyph sticker — it now rotates around the sticker's own anchor (byte-identical when no override exists). Deliberate exclusions, disclosed: a colour/fill-kind object never gets a dial (a full-bleed fill has no meaningful orientation); V2 per-layer Rotation sliders stay sliders (sub-layer transforms beside Tilt/Perspective, not 'an object with moveable true'); js/cardDesigner.js's own Refine-panel Spin slider is left unchanged (a separate, older surface with its own refresh plumbing — the quick-edit popup is the surface a Story Author actually taps an object to reach). Verified 40/40 via a new spatial_controls_verify suite across 5 scenarios: pad geometry + one-click step + a REAL press-and-hold repeat (page.mouse.down / 750ms / up) + centre reset + dial drag + keyboard + a canvas repaint pixel check; a moveable:false guardrail object correctly gets no pad and no dial while keeping its colour control; a Story sticker writes st.x/st.y/st.rotation with nothing leaking into elementOverrides; a World glyph sticker's renderer gap proven closed via a ctx.rotate spy; and static checks that all three old sliders are genuinely gone. Three TEST-methodology bugs found and fixed along the way, none of them app bugs: an h/half param typo; a fixture using offset:{x,y} when js/layerEngine.js reads flat offsetX/offsetY (so the seal rendered off-canvas); and a pixel-brightness check that could never work because _layerDrawSticker's glyph branch never sets fillStyle (a pre-existing quirk, out of scope) — replaced with the rotate spy. Regression: both goldenBuilds PASS, four_bugs 36/36 (4 assertions updated from the removed slider to the new dial — the intended, disclosed consequence), fa_replace_everywhere 22/22, legacy_place_controls 15/15, v2_nudge 28/28.
